title: Inflation, Debt, and a Housing Standstill: Provident Bank's 2026 Consumer Survey Captures the State of American Household Finances
summary: New data shows how inflation, rising costs, and elevated interest rates are reshaping household finances in 2026 ISELIN, N.J., May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Bank , a leading New Jersey-based community financial institution, announced today the results of its 2026 Consumer Survey, which examined how American households are navigating persistent inflation, elevated interest rates, and shifting expectations from their financial institutions. The findings reinforce that consumers are under pressure but actively adapting, reassessing spending, managing debt, and making deliberate decisions about where and how to get the financial guidance they need. The survey found that more than 1 in 3 Americans cite keeping up with the rising cost of basic necessities as their top financial priority, ranking it ahead of both savings and debt reduction.
